understanding.goal_understanding: The goal was to place every selectable piece simultaneously on the goal tiles marked '+'. A level is only complete when all goals are occupied and the engine reports WIN.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Movement shifts the currently selected piece by one grid cell (3 pixels) when unobstructed. Adjacent blocks may be pushable, while walls and boundaries can block movement; the blocked indicators are only hints and actions must be tested. CLICK selects another selectable piece using its pixel coordinates, allowing pieces to be controlled independently. Efficient planning is important because each level has a finite step budget.
